type.description: SCHEMA (schemaId), TABLE (tableId), COLUMN (columnId), RELATION (relationId), TERM (termId), WORD (wordId), DOMAIN (domainId), HISTORY (historyId)

id.description: The id exactly as given in the metadata

name.description: The name exactly as given in the metadata

tableId.description: COLUMN only: the tableId of its table

id.description: termId or domainId exactly as given in the metadata

targetType.description: TABLE or COLUMN : the target given in the request

targetId.description: tableId (TABLE) or columnId (COLUMN) of the target given in the request

description.description: Proposed business description of the target, in the requested language. State only what the metadata supports; mark guesses as guesses.

certainty.description: VERIFIED: every statement is stated in the metadata. INFERRED: partly inferred from names and structure. UNKNOWN: the meaning cannot be determined from the metadata.

nameInterpretation.description: How the physical name and abbreviations read, word by word, based on the standard words given (null if not applicable)

termRecommendation.description: COLUMN only: an existing standard term from the metadata that fits the column (null if none fits)

domainRecommendation.description: COLUMN only: an existing standard domain from the metadata that fits the column (null if none fits)

related.description: Related tables or columns from the metadata and why (at most 10)

evidence.description: Every metadata item the description relies on (at most 30)

unknowns.description: What cannot be determined from the metadata (code value meanings, tax inclusion, currency, date basis, personal data, processing order, actual usage)

questions.description: Questions to ask the data owner to confirm the description
